summary.text: Suzanne Andresen is the Republican candidate for the Maine House of Representatives, District 49, in the November 3, 2026 general election. She was previously the Republican candidate for Maine State Senate District 24 in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Suzanne Andresen ran in the 2024 general election for Maine State Senate District 24, in which Democrat Denise Tepler defeated Jeffrey K. Pierce and Andresen.
